title: Use the “Robotics Database Overview” slide in Confluence/Miro by zooming in to read details
summary: Open the Confluence/Miro reference slide titled “Robotics Database Overview” and zoom in so the slide text is readable.
when_to_use: When you need to read the content on the “Robotics Database Overview” slide shown in the OptiSweep Training Day 2 segment, and the slide text is not readable at the current zoom level.
not_for: Do not use this procedure as a troubleshooting guide for any live OptiSweep system behavior; the source only describes zooming a training reference slide.

steps.title: Open the “Robotics Database Overview” slide in Confluence/Miro

steps.title: Zoom in on the “Robotics Database Overview” slide to read text
steps.purpose: Make the slide text readable by increasing zoom level.
